en: Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a steep hill crowned by a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle‑like complex of tall, steep‑roofed buildings. At the foot of the hill are smaller houses and a riverside quay with a long retaining wall. The composition and trimmed corners resemble an old postcard or photographic plate. No visible printed text appears on the front.
